nam.label: NAM v4.2.11 physics as NCEP ran it: Ferrier-Aligo, BMJ, MYJ, Janjic surface layer, Noah, NMMB RRTM, GWD

hrrrv5.label: RRFS v2 hrrrv5 suite on the NMMB dycore: TEMPO (aerosol-aware, hail-aware), MYNN-EDMF PBL, MYNN surface layer, RUC LSM (9 levels), RRTMG LW/SW with MYNN cloud fraction, GSL orographic drag, no deep convection; ArWen's GPU schemes through the NMMB column adapter
hrrrv5.source_suite: RRFSx/MPAS-Model hrrrv5 (mp_tempo, bl_mynnedmf, sf_mynnsfclay, sf_ruc, bl_ugwp_gwdo, rrtmg_lw/sw, cld_fraction_mynn, convection off)
declared: MYNN qke is held per column by the scheme and not advected (RRFS advects it)
the TDFI digital filter runs adiabatic for this suite (the column physics state is not rewound by the filter)
GSL drag statistics (large and small scale) come from init_ugwp_oro on this grid (rw_hex_ugwp_oro), as RRFS reads ugwp_oro_data

rapv5.label: RAP v5 suite on the NMMB dycore (NOAA 13 km): Thompson aerosol-aware (mp28), Grell-Freitas scale-aware deep convection (MYNN-EDMF mass flux carries shallow, ishallow 0 as WRF requires), MYNN-EDMF PBL, MYNN surface layer, RUC LSM (9 levels), RRTMG with MYNN cloud fraction, GSL orographic drag; ArWen GPU schemes through the NMMB column adapter. GF is paired with mp28 because gpuwm refuses GF with TEMPO (no verified cumulus phase-output contract for mp_physics 900)
rapv5.source_suite: RAP v5 (mp_physics 28, cu_physics 3 GF, bl_pbl 5 MYNN-EDMF, sf_sfclay 5, sf_surface 3 RUC, gsl drag)
declared: MYNN qke is held per column by the scheme and not advected (RRFS advects it)
the TDFI digital filter runs adiabatic for this suite (the column physics state is not rewound by the filter)
GSL drag statistics (large and small scale) come from init_ugwp_oro on this grid (rw_hex_ugwp_oro), as RRFS reads ugwp_oro_data
the NMMB tracer table is the TEMPO layout (12 water slots); mp28 uses qv qc qr qi qs qg ni nr nc nwfa nifa of it

woof-nam-next-12km.label: WOOF-NAM next, 12 km (optional preset, 2026-11-09, winter/CAD priority): NAM 12 km parent grid; NAM's MYJ PBL, NAM surface layer and BMJ convection kept; RUC LSM (9 levels, urban cells on NAM Noah) from HRRR's soil analysis where HRRR covers the grid, the CDF soil start elsewhere; TEMPO microphysics with melting reflectivity; RTE+RRTMGP radiation; NOAA-GSL UGWP drag; GFS start
declared: TEMPO defaults to v3.2.5; version selection follows NAMGPU_TEMPO_VERSION
NAMGPU_PHYS_BAND_ROWS=0: the RUC seam runs on the whole grid, not in physics bands
outside HRRR's footprint (most of Canada, Alaska, Mexico) RUC starts from the CDF-matched source soil remapped to 9 levels; the HRRR edge is a hard seam (no blend)
urban cells (IGBP 13, 31-33) stay on NAM Noah's urban treatment (NAMGPU_RUC_URBAN=noah; wedge lane 2026-11-09)
dominant precipitation-type products are available in the folded package
the frozen nam suite stays the default; this optional preset requires the configured soil and column-physics inputs
BMJ is selected at 12 km

woof-nam-next-7p6km.label: WOOF-NAM next, 7.6 km (optional preset, 2026-11-09, winter/CAD priority): NAM North America footprint at 7.6 km (na7p6); NAM's MYJ PBL and NAM surface layer kept; New Tiedtke convection with shallow on; RUC LSM (9 levels, urban cells on NAM Noah) from HRRR's soil analysis where HRRR covers the grid, the CDF soil start elsewhere; TEMPO microphysics with melting reflectivity; RTE+RRTMGP radiation; NOAA-GSL UGWP drag; GFS start
declared: TEMPO defaults to v3.2.5; version selection follows NAMGPU_TEMPO_VERSION
NAMGPU_PHYS_BAND_ROWS=0: the RUC seam runs on the whole grid, not in physics bands
outside HRRR's footprint (most of Canada, Alaska, Mexico) RUC starts from the CDF-matched source soil remapped to 9 levels; the HRRR edge is a hard seam (no blend)
urban cells (IGBP 13, 31-33) stay on NAM Noah's urban treatment (NAMGPU_RUC_URBAN=noah; wedge lane 2026-11-09)
dominant precipitation-type products are available in the folded package
the frozen nam suite stays the default; this optional preset requires the configured soil and column-physics inputs
New Tiedtke with shallow convection is selected at 7.6 km; full 7.6 km runtime qualification remains pending
